# Third-party provenance

TauricResearch/TradingAgents is the framework used by the native adapter. The preserved pin is v0.7.1, commit c4544913a14ed3df5f1ed7b9e8483270ce20682a, repository https://github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents.git. `UPSTREAM.json` records the historical inspection. The checkout is excluded; the original Apache-2.0 license is copied exactly to `third_party/TradingAgents/LICENSE`.

The TrustKernel implementation is a sidecar; the preserved upstream inspection reported no source modifications. This statement applies to the pinned inspected checkout, not arbitrary future versions. Installed dependencies retain their own licenses and are installed through the lock/upstream requirements rather than vendored wholesale. Provider news/market content is not re-licensed by this notice.

No license has been selected for newly authored TrustKernel code by the repository preparation process. A user decision is needed before describing the entire project as available under a chosen open-source license. This does not delay local review, staging, inventory or offline demonstration.
